name: rainmd
description: Molecular dynamics in the browser on WebGPU, from AMBER topologies

scripts.test:gpu: node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/check-bonded.mjs && node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/check-fft.mjs && node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/check-pme.mjs && node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/check-nonbonded.mjs && node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/check-forces.mjs && node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/check-integrator.mjs && node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/check-minimiser.mjs && node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/check-barostat.mjs && node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/check-analysis.mjs && node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/check-displacement.mjs && node tools/gpu-node.mjs tools/gpu/probe-ribbon-shader.mjs
scripts.test:gpu:page: node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/check-bonded.mjs && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/check-fft.mjs && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/check-pme.mjs && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/check-nonbonded.mjs && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/check-forces.mjs && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/check-integrator.mjs && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/check-minimiser.mjs && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/check-barostat.mjs && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/check-analysis.mjs && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/check-displacement.mjs && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --module=tools/gpu/probe-ribbon-shader.mjs
scripts.test:page:view: node tools/gpu-page.mjs --view=helix --draw=ribbon --shot-of="#viewer" --screenshot=/tmp/rainmd-helix.png && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --view=strand --draw=ribbon --azimuth=-1.954 --elevation=-0.135 --shot-of="#viewer" --screenshot=/tmp/rainmd-strand.png && node tools/gpu-page.mjs --view=mixed --draw=both --azimuth=0.9 --elevation=0.25 --shot-of="#viewer" --screenshot=/tmp/rainmd-mixed.png
